current.changeLog:
Обновлён дизайн ангарного мода. Исправлено отображение «Нет данных» для танков.
Updated the Garage mod design. Fixed the “No data” display issue for tanks.

previous.changeLog:
- Removing mods from My Mods now starts reinstalling the remaining mods. (Removing Auto mods; Auto-install enabled; WoT not running.)
- Adding mods from Browse Catalog now starts installation right away. (Auto mods only; Auto-install enabled; WoT not running.)
- Mod details now show file name and file size on separate lines.
- Tooltips now open immediately across the app.
- Button labels are now clearer and more explicit, so actions are easier to understand at first glance.
- When you complete required mod options in Browse Catalog, the mod is selected automatically.
- Fixed: mods that reuse the same file name across versions now download the correct latest version.

current.changeLog:
•	Fixed RAR archive extraction that could produce corrupted mod files.
•	Opening Browse Catalog now focuses the search field so you can start typing immediately.
•	Installed Version now uses compatibility colors when its game version matches Latest Version; other versions remain neutral.
•	About now includes a direct link to Stars Mod Installer on WGMods next to Discord.
•	Buttons now clearly say “Install selected mods” and “Uninstall selected mods”.
•	Tooltips explain automatic and manual installation, and warn when mod files may need to be removed by hand.
•	The Auto-install is off warning opens the setting where automatic mod changes can be turned on.
•	Pending changes explain how to apply them, and failed operations offer a shortcut to Diagnostics.
•	An empty My Mods list points you to Browse Catalog; adding mods no longer needs a separate confirmation message.

previous.changeLog: Moving Average and Damage Efficiency bars now draw a per-value shadow behind each number instead of one backdrop behind the whole bar, and their box is tighter, so you can drag them closer to the bottom of the screen.

current.changeLog:
Client upgrade: retargeted to WoT EU 2.4.0.2.
In-battle bars — MoE %: both centre bars now show your Mark of Excellence percentage in brackets beside the current damage, in both orientations. Moving Average: your live MoE % with this battle counted. Damage Efficiency: the MoE % this battle's damage alone is worth.
New settings (Progress Bar column, after Scale), all on by default:
Moving Average: show % / Moving Average: show change
Damage Efficiency: show % / Damage Efficiency: show change
The % uses the same font size as the damage number. Both bars' surfaces grew slightly to fit it (the horizontal Moving Average bar is wider; the vertical bars are wider on the left). Your saved bar position is kept.
Compatible with World of Tanks EU 2.4.0.2.

previous.changeLog: Fixed animated custom camouflages and projection decals sometimes showing missing textures after switching World of Tanks clients or failing to restart after leaving Exterior. Large GIF and animated WebP imports now run in the background with visible progress instead of freezing the Local Assets page. Also improved animation resource synchronization, loading, and fallback behavior.

current.changeLog: Restart local camouflage and projection-decal animations after returning from battle results; keep local animations running across Ready-triggered hangar vehicle reloads; rotate Creations diagnostics at 2 MiB and keep one previous log; add optional Exterior Studio compatibility.
